qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:d6ea740e-6038-4f1c.description: 2nd Shift Parts & Plates Foreman Location: York, PA Job Type: Direct Hire Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–12:00 AM Starting rate: $32.00 per hour, with higher pay available based on experience, plus a $3.00/hour shift differential for second shift. Position Overview We are hiring a Parts & Plates Foreman to oversee second-shift shop production and provide leadership to fabrication personnel. This role is responsible for coordinating employees, materials, equipment, production schedules, deliveries, and quality requirements to support efficient shop operations. The Foreman will work closely with internal teams, vendors, and other facilities to maintain production flow, address operational needs, and help ensure work is completed accurately and on time.
responsibilities: Lead and support shop personnel during second-shift operations
Coordinate daily fabrication activities, staffing, workload, and production priorities
Maintain production and fabrication schedules
Monitor quality, productivity, and adherence to safety and company procedures
Coordinate material deliveries and communicate product status, quality, and delivery needs
Work with project management, purchasing, logistics, other departments, and fabrication facilities to meet project deadlines
Establish and maintain effective fabrication procedures and quality-control practices
Monitor equipment, tools, buildings, and inventory
Maintain appropriate inventory levels in coordination with management, purchasing, and first-shift leadership
Work with vendors and suppliers as needed
Adjust work hours and shop resources when necessary to meet delivery schedules
Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, employee performance, and quality
Provide operational updates and recommendations to management
qualifications: Supervisory or managerial experience required
Strong knowledge of the structural steel fabrication industry
Excellent spoken and written English
Strong communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
High school diploma or equivalent
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to make sound decisions and manage competing production priorities

rws-rws:lever:2dfbc5a2-255f-4631-a59a-20.description: We are looking for AI Data Specialist to support the improvement of AI-generated content in Tamil. Job Type: Freelance Location: Remote in India Work Schedule: Part-time. Flexible, work whenever you want Start Date: Immediately Rate: 4 USD/hour (rates vary per country. If you are based elsewhere, the rates will be different) Help Shape the Future of AI Are you a student, recent graduate, stay-at-home parent, gig worker, or professional seeking flexible remote work? Are you interested in shaping the development and safety of today’s AI models? What You’ll Do The role involves performing diverse data-related tasks, including: - Data collection, evaluation, and annotation. - Pairwise comparisons. - Counting tasks. - Object tagging and labeling across different content types (audio, video, images, or collected data) What we’re looking for: - Native-level fluency in Tamil - English Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in English at B2, C1, C2, or Native level. - AI & Data Capabilities (Preferred): Experience in one or more of the following areas: machine learning tasks, data collection and preprocessing, data evaluation and quality assurance, and data annotation and labeling. What We Offer - 100% remote work - Flexible schedule - Opportunity to earn extra income - Timely payments - The job is ideal for students, part-timers, or stay-at-home parents Please apply using a GMAIL account if you have one. #LI-PR1505
